newsitem.title: POLAND: JUTRZENKA PROSPECTUS NEEDS MORE DETAILS.
newsitem.headline: JUTRZENKA PROSPECTUS NEEDS MORE DETAILS.

text.p: Polish confectioner Jutrzenka SA asked the Polish Securities Commission to put off the review of its planned new share issue after the commission demanded changes in the issue prospectus, Jutrzenka's head said.

Grzegorz Dolkowski told Reuters on Friday the company had to give more information in the prospectus on how the one-million-share issue would be allotted and distributed and such details would available only after Jutrzenka's extraordinary shareholders meeting on February 24.
"The requirements of Polish Securities Commission are higher and we have to make some changes in our issue prospectus...but we should be able to carry out the subscription in April," he said.
He also said the firm would apply to the KPW to renew its review of the issue prospectus immediately after the shareholders meeting.
Jutrzenka had planned to issue the new common shares ex- rights to selected financial investors who would offer the best price.
The company, which netted 10 million zlotys last year, seeks to move this year to the Warsaw bourse's main market from the parallel floor.
